name: Product Page Shipping for WooCommerce
author: Arif Hussain

sections.description:
This plugin displays a customizable shipping information box on the WooCommerce single product pages. Users can control different elements of the shipping display like Country, Shipping method, Cost, and estimated delivery. The pro addon adds additional functionality to the plugin by enabling customers to make shipping choices through a popup shipping selector.

Plugin Settings

Once you install and activate the plugin, you can configure the plugin by going to the plugin settings page under Dashboard/Settings/Product Page Shipping for WooCommerce.

External Services

While Product Page Shipping for WooCommerce can be used as a standalone plugin, it’s features can be extended with the pro addon available from the plugin URL (Pibit.co). Once a license key is obtained, the pro addon can be directly installed to WordPress as a normal plugin. To enable pro features, this plugin connects with Pibit licensing server through API. The plugin doesn’t share any user information with the Pibit server, instead it verifies license credentials like validity, and user email. Pibit Terms & Privacy

sections.installation:
You can install the plugin either through FTP or directly from the WordPress Dashboard.
Through FTP:
1. Upload the plugin .Zip file to /wp-content/plugins/
2. Extract the Zip file.
3. Go to Dashboard>Plugins>Installed Plugins, and activate.
From Your WordPress Dashboard:
1. Go to Dashboard>Plugins>Add Plugin>Upload Plugin
2. Choose the plugin Zip file from your computer, Click Install Now, then activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
1. Does this plugin work with all themes?

    Yes, it works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

  2. Can I hide the shipping cost?

    Yes, you can toggle the shipping cost in the plugin settings under the General Settings tab. You can also toggle other element like Country flag and ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival).

  3. Can I set a default shipping method?
    Yes, you can set your default shipping method logic in the general settings section. You can either choose to show the First Method in Zone (Default), Cheapest Available, or Free Shipping (If available).
